expectations.text: States that the on-behalf-of-user draft has expired and should not be built against
expectations.evidence: "The draft-oauth-ai-agents-on-behalf-of-user draft expired in early 2026... Building on an expired individual draft..."

expectations.text: Notes that actor_token itself is an RFC 8693 parameter that remains usable, while requested_actor has no successor
expectations.evidence: "`requested_actor` has no successor." and "`actor_token` itself is an RFC 8693 parameter, so the part of the draft you wanted is safe to use".

expectations.text: Recommends RFC 8693 token exchange with the actor chain recorded in the act claim
expectations.evidence: "RFC 8693 token exchange... `act` claim. The issued token records the actor chain".

expectations.text: States that a Web Bot Auth signature identifies the operator and carries no user authorization
expectations.evidence: "Web Bot Auth answers 'which company's agent sent this?' It explicitly excludes authorization and delegation."

expectations.text: Rejects skipping the OAuth step for signed requests
expectations.evidence: "the signature gets added on top of the OAuth token, never in place of it."

expectations.text: Rejects 90-day delegated tokens and requires delegated tokens not to outlive the user token they derive from
expectations.evidence: "Delegated tokens last hours or days, never 'until revoked'. They must never outlive the user token they derive from."

expectations.text: Proposes client credentials or workload identity federation minting short tokens for unattended fleets
expectations.evidence: "Fleets mint short access tokens from it (client credentials grant) or from workload identity federation."

expectations.text: Requires a named sponsoring human for each agent credential
expectations.evidence: "Sponsor | A named human or admin at the customer for every agent credential".

expectations.text: Requires per-agent revocation that does not log the human out
expectations.evidence: Says "Revocation | Per agent, from the user's settings and the customer admin console" but never states it must not log the human out.

expectations.text: Recommends sender-constrained tokens (for example DPoP or mTLS) where clients support them
expectations.evidence: "Bind tokens to the agent instance with DPoP or mTLS where the client supports it."

expectations.text: Warns that a major CDN verifier implemented an earlier Signature-Agent form and may reject the dictionary form, so test against both
expectations.evidence: "Cloudflare's verifier implements an earlier header form and rejects the dictionary form... Sign with both forms and compare results."

expectations.text: Labels Web Bot Auth as an IETF working-group draft, not a final standard
expectations.evidence: "the draft is still moving"; "The working group adopted it in September 2026, so expect changes."
